title: Rewards Phase 2: Release of 767,993 KII
summary:
This proposal activates Phase 2 of the KiiChain rewards program by setting a new release schedule on the rewards module, replacing the Phase 1 schedule that ends 2026-11-08T21:00:00Z.

A total of 767,993 KII will be released linearly from the rewards pool, starting when this proposal is executed (targeting 2026-11-12) and ending Tuesday, 2027-01-12T21:00:00Z, roughly two months (61 days, ~12,590 KII/day).

Parameters:
- Total amount: 767,993 KII (767993000000000000000000 akii)
- Released so far: 0 KII
- End time: 2027-01-12T21:00:00Z
